pick.headline: Gorbachev becomes Soviet leader
pick.summary: On 11 March 1985 the CPSU Central Committee elected Mikhail Gorbachev general secretary.
pick.significance: At 54 Gorbachev was the youngest Politburo member. His reforms would end the Cold War and, unintentionally, the Soviet Union.

alternates.headline: Lithuania declares independence
alternates.summary: On 11 March 1990 Lithuania's Supreme Council declared the restoration of the country's independence, the first Soviet republic to do so.
alternates.significance: Moscow responded with an economic blockade. The declaration set off the chain of secessions that ended the USSR.
